'''Tyson''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Rebel pilot|pilot]] who flew under the [[callsign]] "[[Gold Three]]" for [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], a [[starfighter]] [[squadron]] composed of [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s under the command of [[Captain]] [[Jon Vander]]. In [[2 BBY]], Tyson was [[Death|killed]] during the [[Operation Handoff|skirmish]] in the [[Archeon Nebula]].

==Biography==
Tyson<ref name="Trivia Gallery">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/secret-cargo-trivia-gallery|text="Secret Cargo" Trivia Gallery}} {{C|Slide 7}}</ref> was a [[rebel pilot]] in [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] under the [[callsign]] "[[Gold Three]]." His squadron flew [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing starfighters]]. In [[2 BBY]], he and his fellow pilots escorted the former [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Senator]] [[Mon Mothma]] into hiding after she had denounced the [[Ghorman Massacre]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" /> After Gold Squadron and Mothma's [[Taylander shuttle]] ''[[Chandrila Mistress]]''<ref name="Chandrila Mistress DB">{{Databank|chandrila-mistress|Chandrila Mistress}}</ref> rendezvoused with the rebel cell [[Spectres]]'s ship ''[[Ghost]]'' in deep space, Tyson and his fellow pilots began docking under the ''Ghost''{{'s}} cargo bay to [[Fuel|refuel]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

Tyson and Gold Squadron along with the young rebel pilot [[Ezra Bridger]] then skirmished with an [[Arquitens-class command cruiser|''Arquitens''-class command cruiser]] and its [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] escorts. During the skirmish, Tyson and his fellow pilots followed [[Gold Leader]] [[Captain]] [[Jon Vander]]'s orders to fire their [[ion cannon]]s at the light cruiser. They then bombed the ship with their [[proton torpedo]]es before fleeing into hyperspace with the ''Ghost'', which was now carrying Mothma and her crew.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

While traveling through the [[Archeon pass]] to [[Dantooine]], the rebel convoy was [[Operation Handoff|pursued]] by [[Commander]] [[Vult Skerris]]' prototype [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]], Vander sent Tyson and [[Gold Four (Archeon Nebula)|Gold Four]] to intercept the new TIE. However, the Y-wing pilots were unable to penetrate the new TIE fighter's powerful [[deflector shield]]s. Skerris then shot down Tyson and Gold Four, killing both of them.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Personality and traits==
Tyson was a [[human]] [[Gender|man]] who flew with the rebellion's Gold Squadron in [[2 BBY]]. He had dark skin, brown eyes, and black hair. Tyson wore an orange jumpsuit and helmet. He flew a [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber|Y-wing starfighter]]. While a competent starfighter pilot, he was no match for Commander Skerris' TIE Defender.<ref name="Secret Cargo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tyson first appeared in [[Secret Cargo]], the eighteen episode of [[Star Wars Rebels Season Three|season three]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''. He was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]], who also provides the voice for numerous other star wars characters, most notably [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Secret Cargo" />
